description: This file defines controller functions for managing billing history, including adding, listing, clearing, retrieving last bill number, removing, and editing billing records in a Node.js backend.

methods.name: addBillingHistory
methods.description: Creates and saves a new billing history record based on request data, including date/time formatting and calculations.

methods.name: listBillingHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all billing history records.

methods.name: retrieveLastProduct
methods.description: Fetches the most recent billing record to generate the next bill number.

methods.name: removeHistory
methods.description: Deletes a billing record by ID from request headers.

methods.name: editBillHistory
methods.description: Updates an existing billing record with new data.
